title: A durable working preference settled for an existing person page
turns: Hi. I've got a 1:1 with Tavi Brennock on Thursday. What do you have on how she likes to work, so I can plan for it?

That's useful. Update from this week: Tavi told me she's moving her focus time to the early morning, so she no longer takes meetings before 10:00, and she wants the 1:1 agenda in her inbox by the evening before. I'll plan Thursday around that.

answer_key.reference: The person reported a lasting change in how Tavi Brennock works: she now keeps the early morning for focus time, takes no meetings before 10:00, and wants the 1:1 agenda in her inbox by the evening before. This belongs on Tavi Brennock's person page (for example under Working preferences), alongside her existing preferences, which stay. The Thursday 1:1 itself is a one-off and needs no page. No other page should change.
